title: ClearPath Managed IT Services Seat Administration: Adds, Removals, True-Ups and Proration
content:
**1. How seats change.** Under ClearPath Managed IT Services, seats are added and removed one named user at a time under a service desk user onboarding or user offboarding ticket, at go-live as the initial baseline, and on the tier's true-up snapshot day of each month as a monthly true-up when the client's licensed directory users exceed or fall below the covered seats.

**2. When seat changes may be posted.** Seat changes may be posted only while the agreement status is active or notice given, as shown on the agreement's system record.

**3. Business days.** Business days are Monday through Friday excluding the observed holiday list.

**4. New users.** A new-user onboarding is ready on the requested start date only when the onboarding ticket was opened at least the tier's new-user lead time in business days before that date. Otherwise the account is enabled on the business day that is that many business days after the ticket was opened, and the seat's effective date is the date the account was actually enabled.

*Hypothetical case, lead time 3 business days, no holiday in the period:* a ticket opened on a Monday for a Thursday start is ready on Thursday (Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday make 3 business days). The same ticket for a Wednesday start is not; the account is enabled on Thursday, and the seat takes effect on the date the account was actually enabled.

**5. Offboarding.** An offboarding request received on a business day before the tier's same-day offboarding cutoff (US Eastern) is completed that day, otherwise on the next business day, and the seat removal's effective date is the completion date. An emergency offboarding for an involuntary termination is opened as a P1 security concern and completed on receipt.

**6. Proration of additions.** Every seat addition is prorated: the proration charge equals the per-seat rate multiplied by the seats added and by the number of calendar days from the effective date through the last day of that calendar month inclusive, divided by the number of days in that month, rounded half up to the cent. It is billed on the next monthly invoice under the service month of the effective date.

*Hypothetical case:* 2 seats at 100.00 taking effect on 21 April are prorated over 10 days (21 to 30 April) of a 30-day month: 100.00 times 2 times 10 divided by 30 is 66.666..., billed as 66.67 under the April service month.

**7. Removals.** Seat removals never generate a credit or refund for the current service month: the removed seat stays billed through the end of the month in which it was removed and drops out of the monthly fee from the next service month. A seat removal may take the covered seats below the minimum-commitment floor, but billing never falls below the floor.
